parameters.notes: Receive SMS booking requests, normalize the payload, extract intent, create a pending appointment, and confirm via SMS.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO users (id, phone, preferred_channel, preferred_language, is_visually_impaired, full_name, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '{{ $json.phone }}', 'sms', 'unknown', false, NULL, now()) ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET preferred_channel = 'sms' RETURNING id, phone, preferred_language;

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Return ONLY valid JSON with intent, service, date_text, missing_fields."},{"role":"user","content":"{{ $json.message_text }}"}],"temperature":0}

parameters.query: WITH provider AS (SELECT id, available_slots FROM service_providers WHERE service_type = '{{ $json.service }}' LIMIT 1) INSERT INTO appointments (user_id, provider_id, service_type, slot_time, status, created_at) SELECT '{{ $node["Upsert User"].json.id }}'::uuid, provider.id, '{{ $json.service }}', (provider.available_slots->0->>'date')::text || ' ' || (provider.available_slots->0->'times'->>0), 'pending', now() FROM provider RETURNING id, user_id, provider_id, service_type, slot_time, status;

parameters.text: ={{ 'Appointment saved for ' + $json.service + ' on ' + $json.date_text + '. Please confirm if needed.' }}
